summary: Run 5 bootstrap failed: aws command not found at script-fetch step (line 69). SSM fetch silently returned empty (|| true swallowed it).
root_cause: v4 added hf_transfer to the single pip install batch with awscli; a hf_transfer build failure aborted the batch leaving awscli not installed. PATH export alone can't fix a binary that was never installed. Fix: separate tolerated hf_transfer install + AWS CLI v2 official bundle for a deterministic aws path.
